Dear Sir/ Madam,  
 
This is further to our communic ation letter dated 14.08.202 4 wherein the Company had 
informed  the Stock Exchanges that the 7 4th Annual General Meeting of the Company is 
scheduled to be held on Wednesday, September 18, 2024  at 12 00 Hours  IST through 
Video Conferenc ing/ Other Audio -Visual Means, in compliance  with applicable  
provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 , SEBI  (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015  along with  circulars issued by MCA /SEBI  in this 
regard .   
 
In compliance with  the SEBI (Listing Obligation s and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015,  we enclose  herewith  the Annual Report of the Company including 
the Notice of 74th AGM  and the Business Responsibility  and Sustainability  Report  for 
the financial year 20 23-24, which is being  sent through el ectronic mode to the 
Shareholders of the Company . 
 
The 74th Annual Report containing the AGM Notice  and the Business Responsibility  and 
Sustainability  Report  is also uploaded on the Company’s website at  www.shipindia.com  
under ‘Financial Results  Annual Reports ’ section.  Submitted for your information, 
kindly take the same on your records.  
 
Thanking You,  
           
Yours Faithfully,  
For The Shipping Corporation of India Limited
